Unfortunately, three of the six cables were stolen at another of our HPC locations. We would like to ask you to quickly
make an offer to replace the cables. We can act quickly here because the location is monitored by cameras. At MP/R6
170002093, both cables were stolen. At MP/R6 170002092, only one, but the cable management was cut off on both sides.
If you have any questions, please contact our electromobility team at elektromobilitaet@stawag.de
